content.value: Mention the differences between oscillator and alternator. With a negative voltage feedback, an amplifier gives an output of 10 V with an input of 0.5 V. When feedback is removed, it requires 0.25 V input for the same output. Calculate (i) gain without feedback and (ii) feedback fraction, my.
